title: Final Frozen Quantitative Feature Registry for Initial LONG-002E

frozen_baseline_system.note: It is a SYSTEM comparator, not a newly optimized E candidate.

features.D1_evidence_summary: 1.2446x favorable decile lift (clean rate 11.03% vs base rate 8.86%), 21-session block bootstrap 95% CI [1.13, 1.38], 5/5 development years positive lift.
features.limitations: Core momentum reference component of frozen VAM5. Horizon is fixed to 5 sessions; no lookback search authorized.

features.D1_evidence_summary: Strongest univariate feature in D1: 2.2816x favorable decile lift (clean rate 20.22% vs base rate 8.86%), 21-session block bootstrap 95% CI [1.94, 2.70], strictly monotonic decile progression, 5/5 development years positive lift.
features.limitations: Core volatility/movement-capacity input and half of frozen VAM5 baseline. No alternative ATR periods authorized.

features.D1_evidence_summary: 1.2122x favorable decile lift (clean rate 10.75% vs base rate 8.86%), 21-session block bootstrap 95% CI [1.11, 1.33], 5/5 development years positive lift.
features.limitations: Medium-horizon momentum input. No new lookback horizon search authorized.

features.D1_evidence_summary: 1.2536x favorable decile lift (clean rate 11.11% vs base rate 8.86%), 21-session block bootstrap 95% CI [1.08, 1.44], 5/5 development years positive lift.
features.limitations: Longer-horizon momentum input. No new lookback horizon search authorized.

features.D1_evidence_summary: 1.2083x favorable decile lift (clean rate 10.71% vs base rate 8.86%), 21-session block bootstrap 95% CI [1.10, 1.34], 4/5 development years positive lift.
features.limitations: Trend/location input. No alternative moving-average period search authorized.

features.D1_evidence_summary: 1.1967x favorable decile lift (clean rate 10.61% vs base rate 8.86%), 21-session block bootstrap 95% CI [1.07, 1.33], 4/5 development years positive lift.
features.limitations: Trend/location input. No alternative moving-average period search authorized.

features.D1_evidence_summary: 1.2238x favorable decile lift (clean rate 10.85% vs base rate 8.86%), 21-session block bootstrap 95% CI [1.11, 1.34], 5/5 development years positive lift. Strong overlap with return_20 (Spearman rho ~+0.9190).
features.D2_evidence_summary_if_applicable: Reranking VAM5 top-quartile pool resulted in -3.3583 pp precision delta vs matched VAM5 (11.9950% vs 15.3533%), 21-session bootstrap 95% CI [-0.0415, -0.0258], 0/5 development years positive delta.
features.limitations: Strong collinearity with return_20 (rho ~+0.919); standalone reranking under D2 materially underperformed VAM5; may only appear in explicitly registered multivariate E configurations; may NOT be described as independently supported ranking evidence.

features.formula: volume_t / median(volume over PRIOR 20 completed sessions, excluding t)
features.D1_evidence_summary: 1.1307x favorable decile lift (clean rate 10.02% vs base rate 8.86%), 21-session block bootstrap 95% CI [1.07, 1.20], 4/5 development years positive lift.
features.D2_evidence_summary_if_applicable: Standalone reranking evaluated against matched VAM5: candidate precision 12.4321% vs matched VAM5 15.3533% (-2.9212 pp delta, -2,232 clean events), 21-session bootstrap 95% CI [-0.0352, -0.0235] entirely below zero, 0/5 years positive. Final D2 disposition: NOT_SUPPORTED.
features.limitations: D1 univariate association was modestly favorable; D2 standalone reranking was decisively NOT_SUPPORTED; may only be tested as a bounded multivariate/contextual input in E; no manual high-volume reranker; no new threshold/lookback tuning; no claim that D2 supported it.

features.D1_evidence_summary: Preregistered HIGHER direction contradicted: favorable Decile 10 yielded only 6.48% clean rate (0.7307x lift, 21-session CI [0.65, 0.80], 0/5 years favorable). Post-hoc deep pullback Decile 1 showed 14.58% clean rate (1.6448x lift).
features.limitations: Preregistered HIGHER breakout hypothesis contradicted. Post-hoc pullback association is not preregistered and must not be inverted inside E.

features.D1_evidence_summary: Preregistered HIGHER direction contradicted: favorable Decile 10 yielded only 6.10% clean rate (0.6886x lift, 21-session CI [0.59, 0.78], 0/5 years favorable).
features.limitations: Preregistered HIGHER breakout hypothesis contradicted. Direction inversion prohibited inside E.

features.formula: median(true_range over latest 5 sessions) / median(true_range over latest 20 sessions)
features.D1_evidence_summary: 1.0087x favorable decile lift (clean rate 8.94% vs base rate 8.86%), 21-session block bootstrap 95% CI [0.96, 1.06], 2/5 development years favorable.
features.limitations: Insufficient/neutral D1 evidence for current bounded registry; 95% CI spans 1.00; lacks standalone or conditional evidence.

features.formula: median(as_traded_close * volume over latest 20 sessions) / median(as_traded_close * volume over latest 60 sessions) - 1
features.D1_evidence_summary: 1.0022x favorable decile lift (clean rate 8.88% vs base rate 8.86%), 21-session block bootstrap 95% CI [0.91, 1.10], 3/5 development years favorable.
features.limitations: Insufficient/neutral D1 evidence for current bounded registry; essentially zero edge over common base rate.

features.formula: sum(volume for sessions in latest 20 where close_t > close_t-1) / sum(volume over latest 20)
features.D1_evidence_summary: Preregistered HIGHER direction contradicted: 0.8842x favorable decile lift (clean rate 7.84% vs base rate 8.86%), 21-session CI [0.81, 0.96], 0/5 development years favorable.
features.limitations: Preregistered HIGHER hypothesis contradicted. Inverse univariate association.

features.D1_evidence_summary: Evaluated as date-level market-regime diagnostic. Date-decile lift 1.5473x, but 21-session bootstrap CI spans [0.90, 2.18] and annual stability only 1/5 years due to macro date clustering (2020 post-crash bounce).
features.D2_evidence_summary_if_applicable: Used to define descriptive Lower (bottom 30%), Middle (mid 40%), and Upper (top 30%) market regimes; confirmed candidate delta degradation was uniform across all regimes.
features.limitations: Permitted use strictly as descriptive market context, regime diagnostics, and robustness reporting. It must NOT become an outcome-tuned ranking feature in initial LONG-002E.

features.D1_evidence_summary: Mathematical identity confirmed: produces identical same-date cross-sectional decile ranks and 1.2122x lift as return_20 on identical non-null populations. Cross-sectional redundancy diagnostic.
features.limitations: Reference and redundancy diagnostic rather than distinct independent ranking feature.

post_hoc_findings.description: D1 post-hoc observation that Decile 1 (stocks most deeply pulled back from highs) showed 1.6448x clean-event lift.
post_hoc_findings.governance_rule: Not preregistered; excluded from initial E registry. No reverse proximity feature, pullback threshold, dip score, or inverted proximity rank may be introduced inside LONG-002E without a separate preregistered research task approved by Gary Yang.

optional_data_families.rationale: No completed quantitative D-stage evidence currently qualifies these inputs for the frozen initial E registry. May be reconsidered only through a separate Gary-approved, preregistered development amendment.

silent_feature_engineering_prohibitions: No new volume ratios or hand-tuned thresholds
No indicator-period searches outside frozen registry definitions
